title: The RSS Feed Retriever WordPress plugin through 1.6.10 does not validate a user-supplied URL before fetching it…
description: The RSS Feed Retriever WordPress plugin through version 1.6.10 has a vulnerability where it does not validate user-supplied URLs before fetching them server-side. This allows unauthenticated users to make the site retrieve arbitrary internal or external resources and read the response, due to the use of a bundled HTTP library that lacks WordPress's private-network protections.
